parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description:
The end of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.

> The time range cannot exceed 30 days.

parameters.name: EntityObject
parameters.description: The operation object used to filter results.

parameters.name: EntityType
parameters.description:
The type of the operation object used to filter results. Valid values:

- **1**: IP Address of Anti-DDoS Proxy instance
- **2**: Anti-DDoS Pro and Anti-DDoS Premium mitigation plan
- **3**: ECS instance
- **4**: full logs

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number to return in a paging query. For example, to query the first page, set the value to **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: **50**.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Pro and Anti-DDoS Premium instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description:
The beginning of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.

> The time range cannot exceed 30 days.
